text_original: I am happy to help you with school registration in the city. School registration is carried out according to the relevant school year: * **Registration for the current school year:** The required documents must be submitted online. * Registration of a new resident in an elementary school * Registration of a new resident in a secondary school * **Registration for the next school year:** The required documents must be submitted online. * Registration of a new resident in an elementary school * Registration of a new resident in a secondary school When contacting the registration department, the following documents must be provided, including a photocopy: 1. An ID card of both parents with a completely open appendix, which includes the student's details and an updated address in the city. 2. Confirmation of the property owner/property tax account in the name of the student's parents, which matches the address listed on the ID card. Confirmation can be obtained from the collection department after presenting the rental or purchase contract registered in the name of the student's parents. * In cases where the property tax is not in the name of the student's parents, an affidavit of residence signed by an attorney and a copy of the property tax bill in the name of the property owner must be presented. Divorced/unmarried/living separately/single parents: * In cases of new registration, transfer requests or requests for permission to leave the city/abroad, parents who live at two separate addresses and are divorced or separated or single are asked, in addition to the relevant documents for each request, to present: * A letter of consent for divorced/separated parents signed by both parents + copies of ID cards + an open appendix with the student's details. * A parent who is the legal guardian of the student and solely responsible for his or her education must attach a judgment stating this. * A single parent will attach an extract from the student's population registry from the Ministry of the Interior. * A declaration and undertaking form for children of divorced, separated, single parents. New residents in the city: * New residents in the city who come from another locality and wish to register their children for first grade will submit the necessary documents online. Future residents in the city, a house under construction/future rental: * Residents who have purchased/rented a house and are documenting moving during the summer vacation before the start of the school year and wish to register their children for first grade, will submit the necessary documents online. New immigrants/returning residents: * New immigrants or returning residents who come from abroad and wish to register their children for first grade, will submit the necessary documents online. Passport holders/without an ID card: * Students with a passport/without an ID card who come from abroad and wish to register their children for first grade will submit the necessary documents online. First grade registration for residents who have changed their residential address within the city: * Residents who have changed their address within the city and wish to register their children for school at the new address will submit the new documents. In addition, you can contact the Student Registration Department at the Netanya Municipality by phone at 09-8362821 or 09-8362896.
label: DEPARTMENT

Enforcement will be carried out on parking prohibitions such as red-and-white parking, double parking, and perpendicular parking.

What types of parking permits are available in the Netanya Municipality? * **Citywide parking permit (50% discount):** A permit that provides a 50% discount on parking fees in regulated locations throughout the city (municipal parking lots and in blue-and-white markings). The permit is issued immediately. * **Regional parking permit (resident):** For residents living in the city center, on streets marked in blue-and-white and who do not have parking adjacent to their building. The permit provides free parking on streets within their area of ​​residence, in addition to a citywide parking permit. * **Parking permit for seniors (golden age):** For city residents over 75 years of age, providing free parking on most city streets (except for main streets where there is entitlement to a 50% discount on parking fees). The permit is issued immediately. * **Disabled parking permit:** Provides free parking throughout the country, on streets marked in blue-and-white and in municipal parking lots belonging to municipalities. * **Parking permit for caregiver of a nursing parent:** Intended for a non-resident child, when nursing care is required for a parent and there is no parking in the building. * **Temporary parking permit:** Will be issued in cases where only some of the documents required to obtain a parking permit have been submitted, or in exceptional cases at the discretion of the Resident Service Center. * **Parking permit for bereaved families:** For families living in the Netanya city center, on streets marked in blue and white. Netanya residents are entitled to discounts in parking lots on the Netanya beaches (Sironit and Poleg) as well as free parking in the Kiryat Eliezer and Kiryat Sapir industrial zones. In addition, there is the option of exchanging a vehicle for a valid parking permit. Submitting an application is done via an online form, along with the required documents. The cost of a parking permit for city residents is 20 NIS. To begin the process of issuing a parking permit, you can fill out an online application form . text_original: I understand that you are interested in updating your address. Before registering a student for school, you must update your student's address. If the address is incorrect, please contact us using the contact form and attach appropriate documents to change the address. After that, you will need to complete the registration on the website. Residents who have changed their address and do not have property taxes in their name will submit: * Updated ID cards of both parents + an open appendix with the student's details and the new address. * Affidavit of place of residence signed by an attorney + a copy of the property tax bill in the name of the property/house owner. * In the case of divorced/separate parents - a population registry extract for the student based on the new address. New residents in the city must submit: * A photocopy of updated ID cards of both parents, on which your son/daughter is listed. * Confirmation from the Revenue Department regarding the residential address. * A deregistration form from the previous authority, even if the child did not attend kindergarten. New immigrants will submit: * A photocopy of passports/ID cards of both parents, on which your son/daughter is listed. * Confirmation from the Revenue Department regarding the residential address. Residents who have changed their address within the city and want to transfer their children to another school will fill out a transfer application and attach: * Updated ID cards of both parents + an open appendix with the student's details and the updated address in the city. * Confirmation of the property owner/property tax account in the name of the student's parents. Another option is to update details at the "Available Government" stations located in the city, where you can change your address, issue a registration extract, and more. The stations are located in the center Resident Service, 2 Hatzoran Street, 1st floor, and on the "Ad HaBayt" bus at varying locations. Please note that the educational space assignment is determined based on the student's residential address updated in the system. In addition, it is possible to change the address for sending property tax bills . Would you like me to elaborate on any of these issues?

text_original: Hello! I'm here to help you with Netanya Municipality issues. To update your property tax payment methods, there are several options: 1. **Payment via direct debit:** You can pay your property tax bill via direct debit through your bank or credit card. The charge will be made every 2nd or 28th of the month. Payments by direct debit have linkage differences (without interest). * To make a payment by direct debit, you must fill out the "Join a Direct Debit at the Bank" form available on the municipality's website. To fill out the online form, you can choose between a residential property tax form or a business property tax form . * You can also fill out the form manually and download it via the appropriate link: Bank Direct Debit Form . 2. **Payment via Credit Card:** You can pay your property tax bill via credit card. The charge will be made every 2nd or 28th of the month, but will actually be collected on the date specified in the personal arrangement with the credit company. * To register for a credit card bill, fill in the details on the credit card standing order form. 3. **Online payment:** You can make an online payment via the municipality's website at the following link: Property tax bill payment . 4. **Telephone payment:** You can make inquiries and payments with a representative by phone at: 076-5300943. 5. **Payment at the Revenue Department offices:** You can come to the department offices and pay directly Sunday-Thursday, from 8:00 AM to 1:00 PM, and on Wednesdays from 4:30 PM to 6:00 PM, at the address: Hatzoran 4A, 2nd floor, Entrance 7, Sapir Business and Technology Park, Netanya. What additional property tax services can I provide you with?

label: LOCATION

text_original: Hello! I am here to provide you with information about the municipality's services. Netanya residents are entitled to a 50% discount on parking fees in regulated spaces throughout the city. To receive the discount, you must submit an application for a parking permit on the municipality's website: Application for a parking permit - Netanya resident Residents who live in the city center, on streets marked in blue and white and do not have parking adjacent to their building, are entitled to a regional parking permit that provides free parking on streets included in their residential area. The list of streets eligible for a parking permit by residential area can be viewed here . Netanya residents over the age of 75 are entitled to a parking permit that provides free parking on most city streets marked in blue and white, except for main streets where there is entitlement to a 50% discount on parking fees. To purchase a "gold permit", you can click here . Please note that, as of January 2021, parking permits are digital and there is no need to affix a parking permit sticker to the vehicle's windshield. The digital signature is updated in all systems (municipal supervision, Pango, Cellopark, and more).

text_original: I have already sent a request for disabled parking markings twice and have not received any response. I have a sign, but people are parking and not leaving me enough space to park.
label: SERVICE_REQUEST

text_original: I understand your frustration. The Netanya Municipality allocates personal parking spaces to disabled people living in the city, but it is important to know that the disability badge is issued by the Ministry of Transport and Road Safety only. Regarding disabled parking, you can submit the following requests: 1. **Request for allocation of a general disabled parking space**: Online form 2. **Request for allocation/renewal of a personal parking space for a disabled vehicle**: Online form Please note that the personal parking space is intended for vehicles carrying a disability badge only, and its number appears on the parking sign. A personal parking space will not be allocated if you have a parking space for exclusive use. The municipality may cancel an allocation if the entitlement no longer exists. There is also the option to submit a **Request for prohibition of parking at the entrance to a private parking lot**: Online form . In addition, you can submit a **Request to the Traffic Committee for marking and/or placing a sign**: Online form . For more information on disabled parking, you can contact the Traffic Committee Department at 09-8603287. Public reception is held on Mondays between 12:00-16:00 and on Wednesdays between 08:30-11:30.

Here are additional details about the process of obtaining a building permit and an information file, which may help you: **Obtaining an information file for a permit:** * The information file contains detailed planning, engineering and spatial information that focuses on the address and the requested work. It includes building rights on the land, coordination of urban infrastructure and planning guidelines from various entities. * The information file is used by the planner/application editor for the purpose of preparing a permit application and constitutes one of the threshold conditions for receiving a permit application. * Submitting an application for an information file is possible only for authorized "application editors" (architects/engineers/architectural engineers/building engineers and more - in accordance with the legal qualification). * You must contact an application editor on your behalf, who will submit the request for information on your behalf using the smart card in his possession, to a licensing system available on the "Information Gateway for Licensing and Construction" website. * The information file will be delivered in an available licensing system to the application editor on your behalf, within 30 working days from the date the application is approved for threshold conditions. For more information, you can refer to the page for obtaining a permit information file on the Netanya Municipality website . **Building permit:** * Building or use without a permit, or in violation of the permit, constitutes a criminal offense. * There are three application tracks for a building permit: * Short track: 25-day process from the plan review stage until the committee's decision. * Full track without reliefs (consistent with the city plan): 45-day process from the plan review stage until the committee's decision. * Full track with reliefs and exceptional uses: 90-day process from the plan review stage until the committee's decision. * The information file is valid for two years from the date of receipt, the subcommittee/licensing authority decision is valid for two years, the measurement map is valid for one year, and the taboo draft is valid for 3 months. For more information, you can refer to the building permit page on the Netanya Municipality website . I am here for any additional questions.

text_original: I am happy to help you with parking permits. You can submit an online application without having to physically visit the Resident Service Center. Issuing a parking permit involves a fee of 20 NIS. There are several types of parking permits: * **Citywide parking permit (50% discount)**: This permit provides a 50% discount on parking fees in regulated locations throughout the city (municipal parking lots and areas marked in blue and white). * **Regional (resident) parking permit**: Intended for residents living in the city center, on streets marked in blue and white, and who do not have parking adjacent to their building. This permit provides free parking on streets included in their residential area. * **Senior Citizen Permit (75+)**: Intended for city residents over the age of 75, and provides free parking on most city streets (except main streets, where there is entitlement to a 50% discount). * **Disabled parking permit**: Provides free parking throughout the country on streets marked in blue and white and in municipal parking lots belonging to municipalities. For further inquiries, you can contact the Resident Service Center at 09-8604400, extension 3. Reception hours are Sunday-Thursday from 08:30-11:30, and on Wednesday also from 16:30-18:30. Telephone answering hours are Monday and Tuesday from 11:30-13:30, and on Wednesday-Thursday from 11:30-12:30. For more information about parking permits, you can visit the municipality's website: Parking Permits .
label: MONEY_FEE

text_original: I understand that you are looking for information about a property tax balance. You can check the status of your property tax account on the municipality's website. In addition, if you have paid an excess amount of property tax, you can submit a request for a refund of the balance of the credit to your bank account. The municipality sends a detailed notification about the balance of the credit, including a form that must be filled out and returned to the municipality with the required documents. If you did not receive the form, you can receive a copy by mail, through the call center, or by e-mail, along with all the required details. Please note that the municipality will refund the balance of the credit to only one bank account. If the property tax account is held by multiple partners, the consent of all parties will be required to transfer the credit to one account. You may need to present original receipts or references to make the payment. The municipality reserves the right to offset the balance of the credit from your other debts. The estimated deposit time is 14 business days from the approval of the request. For your convenience, here is a link to check the balance/debt status of the property tax account: Checking the balance of the property tax account .

text_original: Hi, I'm glad to hear from you! I'm here to provide you with information about municipal services. Regarding Lag BaOmer bonfires, the Netanya Municipality calls on residents to celebrate with an experiential happening without a bonfire, or to reduce and consolidate bonfires on the following evenings: 14.5, 15.5, 17.5. There is a complete prohibition on lighting bonfires in the following areas: all beaches and promenades (including barbecues), public gardens, the Irises Reserve, Winter Lake Park, the Oak Grove, the Kfar Netter Sands, industrial areas, the memorial complex at the "Yad Labanim" house, the Victory Monument, the Caravan Site and the Sculpture Garden. If you have already decided to light a bonfire, it must be placed in clean and exposed public areas only (not in barrels, roads, sidewalks, streets, sports fields). It is necessary to ensure that the bonfire is completely extinguished and the place is left free of debris. Please note that between the dates 28.4.2025-7.5.2025 a Commissioner's Order prohibiting Lighting fires throughout the country. For more information, you can review the fire safety guidelines and places where barbecues are allowed on the municipality's website: Places where barbecues are allowed . Follow the guidelines and avoid fines and inconvenience.

text_original: Hello! I am here to provide information about municipal services. I understand that you are interested in receiving a discount on property taxes due to disability. There are several criteria for receiving a discount, and I will provide you with the relevant information: 1. **Discount for a disabled person of 90% or more:** If the proven degree of medical disability is 90% or more, or if a disability was determined as mentioned before receiving the old age pension, a discount of 40% will be granted. Confirmation from an official institution, such as National Insurance or the Ministry of Finance, must be presented. 2. **Discount for recipients of disability benefits from National Insurance:** A disabled person who is entitled to a full monthly benefit and whose degree of earning capacity is 75% or higher is entitled to a discount of 80% up to 130 square meters. A certificate from National Insurance must be presented regarding the degree of earning capacity and receipt of a disability benefit at a rate of 100%. 3. **Discount for a parent of a disabled child:** A parent of a disabled child who is entitled to benefits according to the National Insurance Regulations (Disabled Child), 5775-2010, is entitled to a discount of 33% for 100 square meters of the apartment's area. A certificate of receipt of disability benefits from National Insurance must be presented. 4. **Discount for victims of hostilities:** Victims of hostilities who are entitled to benefits or a grant according to the Disabled (Benefits and Rehabilitation) Law, 5779-1959, are entitled to a discount of 66% for 70 square meters of their apartment's area. If they live In an apartment with more than 4 people, the discount will be given for 90 square meters of the apartment's surface area. A certificate from the National Insurance Institute must be presented to receive a discount on property taxes. 5. **Discounts for the needy for 2025:** An apartment owner who has incurred extraordinary expenses due to medical treatment or an event that has led to a deterioration in his material condition may submit an application for a discount to the Discounts Committee, which has the authority to grant a discount of up to 70%. In addition, there are **additional discounts** according to various criteria, such as an income test, military/national/civilian service, or specific pensions. In order to submit an application for a discount, the appropriate online form must be filled out and all required certificates attached. Below are relevant forms: * Request for a disabled discount - medical disability * Request for a disabled discount - loss of work capacity * Request for a disabled child discount * Request for a discount based on the income test - 2025 For your information, additional information and useful forms can be found on the municipality's website: * Discount for benefits * Discounts for the needy for 2025 * Request for a discount based on the income test - criteria for 2025 I hope this information will help you.

A certificate of receipt of disability benefits from National Insurance must be presented. 4. **Discount for victims of hostilities:** Victims of hostilities who are entitled to benefits or a grant according to the Disabled (Benefits and Rehabilitation) Law, 5779-1959, are entitled to a discount of 66% for 70 square meters of their apartment's area. If they live In an apartment with more than 4 people, the discount will be given for 90 square meters of the apartment's surface area. A certificate from the National Insurance Institute must be presented to receive a discount on property taxes. 5. **Discounts for the needy for 2025:** An apartment owner who has incurred extraordinary expenses due to medical treatment or an event that has led to a deterioration in his material condition may submit an application for a discount to the Discounts Committee, which has the authority to grant a discount of up to 70%. In addition, there are **additional discounts** according to various criteria, such as an income test, military/national/civilian service, or specific pensions. In order to submit an application for a discount, the appropriate online form must be filled out and all required certificates attached. Below are relevant forms: * Request for a disabled discount - medical disability * Request for a disabled discount - loss of work capacity * Request for a disabled child discount * Request for a discount based on the income test - 2025 For your information, additional information and useful forms can be found on the municipality's website: * Discount for benefits * Discounts for the needy for 2025 * Request for a discount based on the income test - criteria for 2025 I hope this information will help you.

text_original: I am happy to help you with the Netanya beaches. The Netanya Municipality operates 9 declared bathing beaches with lifeguard towers. Two of these beaches are also designated for water sports. Sironit Beach is accessible to people with disabilities. text_original: You can pay your property tax bill via a direct debit through the bank or via a credit card. To pay via **direct debit**: 1. Fill out the form "Join a direct debit at the bank" ( Direct debit joining form ). 2. After filling out the form and receiving bank approval, it must be forwarded to the Standing Orders Department at the Netanya Municipality, along with a telephone number for inquiries, in one of the following ways: * Send by mail: "Standing Orders Department, Revenue Division, Netanya Municipality", 4 A Hatzoran Street, 2nd floor, Entrance 7, Sapir Business and Technology Park, Netanya, 42506. * Send by fax: 09-8352299 or 09-8606525. For payment via **credit card**: * Fill in the details on the standing order form with a credit card . The charge will be made on the 2nd or 28th of the month, but will actually be collected on the date specified in the personal arrangement with the credit company. Payments by standing order with credit cards carry linkage differences (without interest). The credit authorization or standing order can be canceled at any time and without conditions, but it is recommended to notify the cancellation to the municipality in writing shortly in advance, to avoid cancellation fees. Responsibility for the proper execution of the standing order lies with the payer, and he must ensure that the payments are honored. It is not mandatory for the payer to also have a property tax account. Another option is to opt in to receive a property tax voucher directly to your email via this link .

text_original: I am happy to help you with the payment of a parking report. There are several ways to pay the report: * **Payment at the Postal Bank:** You can pay with the voucher attached to the report. * **Payment at an automated call center:** You can pay by credit card by calling 04-6961340, the service is available 24 hours a day. * **Online payment:** You can pay on the Metropark website: Paying a report on the Metropark website . Please note that failure to pay the report on time will result in advanced enforcement actions, including seizures. In addition, there are options for appealing or filing a request to be judged on the report: * **Appealing a parking report:** You can file an appeal within 30 days of receiving the notice. The appeal must be submitted in writing and accompanied by supporting evidence. The appeal can be sent by fax to 15398608609, by mail to P.O. Box 7031, Netanya, ZIP 42120, or through the online system on the Metropark website: Submitting an appeal on the Metropark website . * **Request to be judged on a parking report:** A request to be judged can be submitted within 90 days of receiving the notice. The request must be submitted in writing. The request can be sent by fax to 15398608609, by mail to P.O. Box 7031, Netanya, ZIP 42120, or through the online system on the Metropark website: Submitting a request to be judged on the Metropark website . If the owner of the vehicle did not commit the offense, a request to convert a parking report can be submitted within 90 days of receiving the notice. The request must be submitted in writing, accompanied by an affidavit from the driver of the vehicle and a photocopy of the driver's license. The application can be sent by registered mail to PO Box 7031, Netanya, ZIP Code 42120, or via the online system. For more information, you can contact the Parking Collection Department at 09-8604427.

text_original: The property tax bill can be paid by direct debit through the bank. The charge is made on the 2nd or 28th of the month and the payments carry linkage differences (without interest). The direct debit can be canceled at any time and without conditions, but it is recommended to notify the municipality in writing shortly in advance, thereby saving the order cancellation fee (charged by the bank). The responsibility for the proper execution of the direct debit lies with the payer, and he must ensure that the payments are honored. It is not mandatory for the payer to also be the owner of the property tax account. To make a payment by direct debit, the form "Joining a standing order at the bank" must be filled out. To fill out an online form, it can be found here: Joining a standing order at the bank for the payment of residential/business property tax . You can also fill out a manual form: Joining a standing order at the bank form . Another option is to pay property tax by credit card. The charge is made on the 2nd or 28th of each month, but will actually be collected on the date specified in the personal arrangement with the credit company. Payments by direct debit with credit cards carry linkage differences (without interest). The credit authorization can be canceled at any time and without conditions, but it is recommended to notify the municipality of the cancellation in writing, shortly in advance, and thereby save the fee for canceling the authorization for credit charging. The responsibility for the proper execution of the authorization for credit charging lies with the payer, and he must ensure that the payments are honored. It is not mandatory for the payer to also be the owner of the property tax account. To register for account charging via credit card, fill in the details on the credit card direct debit form . In addition, there are additional ways to pay property taxes, such as online payment, telephone payment, and payment by visiting the municipality offices in person. You can read about all the options on the municipality's website: Property tax payment .

and Duda Gang. * For ages 13+. * Where: Sportek Ir Yamim (after the tennis complex). * When: August 19 at 7:30 PM. * Cost: 50 NIS. * To purchase tickets: Purchase tickets for FULL SUMMER 5. **In the Voice and Sound 2025**: * An evening of tribute to the Yemenite singer of his generation with Zion Golan, Bracha Cohen, Avner Gadassi and more. * During the evening, archive clips from Ovadia Ben Shalom's public activities will be screened. * Where: Heikhal Hatarbut, 4 Raziel St., Netanya. * When: August 19 at 8:00 PM, doors open at 7:30 PM. * Cost: Starting at 80 NIS. * To purchase tickets: In the Piano Complex, singer Ruhama Raz will host a group of singers with the best songs we grew up on 20/8 Tuesday 18:30 – free admission. text_original: When is the swimming season at Sanz Beach?
label: LOCATION

text_original: The bathing season is over and there are no lifeguards until next season. Bathing hours are from 8:30 AM to half an hour before sunset. Sanz Beach also offers separate bathing: * On Sundays and Tuesdays from 8:30 AM to half an hour before sunset - bathing for women. * On Thursdays and Fridays from 8:30 AM to 12:00 PM - bathing for women. * On Mondays and Wednesdays from 8:30 AM to half an hour before sunset - bathing for men. Access to the beach is possible via stairs. The beach offers toilets, showers and first aid services, as well as a volleyball court. Buses close to the beach: lines 650, 64, 613, 60, 614, 612, 407, 270, 851, 975. There is a ban on lighting fires and barbecues on the beach area. The Beaches Department is available for additional questions by calling 09-9678111, Sunday-Thursday, 8:00 AM-4:00 PM. You can find more information about Sanz Beach on the municipality's website: Sanz Beach

text_original: I am happy to help with parking. Parking arrangements and their enforcement in the city of Netanya are defined in the Netanya By-Law (Parking and Parking of Vehicles) 1965. You can perform the following actions: * Paying a parking report: You can pay a parking report at the postal bank with the voucher attached to the report, at an automated call center 24 hours a day using a credit card, by calling 04-6961340 or on the Metropark website: Paying a report on the Metropark website . * Appealing a parking report: You can file an appeal within 30 days of receiving the notice. A written appeal must be submitted with supporting evidence by fax: 15398608609, by mail to the address: P.O. Box 7031, Netanya, ZIP code 42120 or through the application system on the Metropark website: Submitting an appeal on the Metropark website . * Requesting a hearing on a parking report: You can file an appeal within 90 days of receiving the notice. The request must be submitted in writing via Fax: 15398608609, mail to: PO Box 7031, Netanya, ZIP 42120 or via the application system on the Metropark website: Submitting a request for adjudication on the Metropark website . * Request for a parking report reversal: A request for a report reversal can be submitted within 90 days of receiving the notice, along with the following original documents: An affidavit of the driver of the vehicle verified by an attorney and a photocopy of the driver's license. The request can be submitted by registered mail to: PO Box 7031, Netanya, ZIP 42120 or via the online reversal system. Please note that failure to pay the report on the dates specified by law will result in advanced enforcement actions, including seizures. In addition, there are additional useful forms: * Appeal form to the municipal prosecutor on a parking report: Appeal form to the municipal prosecutor on a parking report * Appeal on a parking report: Appeal on a parking report In addition, you can review the relevant municipal bylaw: Netanya Bylaw Parking and Parking of Vehicles . text_original: Where in Netanya is there a center that teaches social skills to children on the continuum?
label: LOCATION

text_original: There are several frameworks in the city of Netanya where you can get answers on the subject of social skills for children: 1. **Social Skills Cultivation Groups**: These groups are intended for children aged kindergarten to first grade, and there are 4-6 children in the group. The activity is delivered by an emotional therapist in expression and creativity and/or a developmental psychologist. Throughout the year, 3 personal meetings will be held with the children's parents to coordinate expectations, set goals and follow-up. 2. **Talking with Dogs**: A group to strengthen social skills through working with dogs, suitable for ages 4-7. This group helps develop tools and abilities on the academic and social-emotional levels, strengthen personal abilities, cope with difficulty and frustration, strengthen self-image and the ability to stand in front of an audience. 3. **Social Skills Workshop**: Small group meetings (up to 5 children) that combine play and creativity, and develop the ability to integrate into play and group activities, help in understanding ways to solve problems in various social situations and strengthen confidence and self-image. In addition, there is the possibility of receiving emotional therapy through the arts at early childhood centers, which can help improve concentration, spontaneity of creativity and play, raise self-image, develop the ability to plan in stages, accept boundaries, relieve stress, improve the ability to express internal content, and develop memory. For further inquiries, you can contact one of the early childhood centers in the city directly. In addition, the referral for treatment can also be made by a pediatrician or the authorized entity within the educational framework. I invite you to contact the Ginsburg Early Childhood Center at 09-8346847, or go to the center at 24 Abba Hillel Silver Street, Netanya. Reception hours are Sunday-Thursday, 8:30-19:00. In addition, you can contact the Special Education Division at 09-8362824/3, or come to the division's offices at 12 Tchernichovsky Street, 1st floor, Netanya. Reception hours are Sunday, Tuesday, Thursday, 8:30-12:00, and Monday, Wednesday, 12:00-15:00. I recommend contacting the Hila's Education and Care Coordinator, Chen Hanoch, at 09-8362834 or come to 12 Tchernichovsky Street, Netanya. You can also contact the Unit for the Care of People with Disabilities and Their Families at 09-8605832 / 09-8605834. For more information on services for special families, you can visit the municipality's website: Information for Special Families

The activity is delivered by an emotional therapist in expression and creativity and/or a developmental psychologist. Throughout the year, 3 personal meetings will be held with the children's parents to coordinate expectations, set goals and follow-up. 2. **Talking with Dogs**: A group to strengthen social skills through working with dogs, suitable for ages 4-7. This group helps develop tools and abilities on the academic and social-emotional levels, strengthen personal abilities, cope with difficulty and frustration, strengthen self-image and the ability to stand in front of an audience. 3. **Social Skills Workshop**: Small group meetings (up to 5 children) that combine play and creativity, and develop the ability to integrate into play and group activities, help in understanding ways to solve problems in various social situations and strengthen confidence and self-image. In addition, there is the possibility of receiving emotional therapy through the arts at early childhood centers, which can help improve concentration, spontaneity of creativity and play, raise self-image, develop the ability to plan in stages, accept boundaries, relieve stress, improve the ability to express internal content, and develop memory. For further inquiries, you can contact one of the early childhood centers in the city directly. In addition, the referral for treatment can also be made by a pediatrician or the authorized entity within the educational framework. I invite you to contact the Ginsburg Early Childhood Center at 09-8346847, or go to the center at 24 Abba Hillel Silver Street, Netanya. Reception hours are Sunday-Thursday, 8:30-19:00. In addition, you can contact the Special Education Division at 09-8362824/3, or come to the division's offices at 12 Tchernichovsky Street, 1st floor, Netanya. Reception hours are Sunday, Tuesday, Thursday, 8:30-12:00, and Monday, Wednesday, 12:00-15:00. I recommend contacting the Hila's Education and Care Coordinator, Chen Hanoch, at 09-8362834 or come to 12 Tchernichovsky Street, Netanya. You can also contact the Unit for the Care of People with Disabilities and Their Families at 09-8605832 / 09-8605834. text_original: Hello! I am here to provide information about the municipality's services. Due to Shavuot on Monday, June 2, 2025, the evacuation day in the East of the city will be brought forward to Sunday, June 1, 2025. Residents of the East of the city please note this important update! The City Cleaning Department deals with the removal of debris and bulky waste that city residents remove according to evacuation days, handling manual and mechanical street cleaning, cleaning activities at events, vehicle scrap removal, maintenance and operation of public toilets, pest control and carcass removal. Debris removal programs, by days and neighborhoods You can get information by street under the My Environment page . Debris removal days in neighborhoods: * Mondays: Neve Itamar, Neot Ganim, Kiryat Rabin, Mishkenot Zevulun, Train Station, Sha'ar Ha'ir, Kiryat Hasharon, Sapir Business and Technology Park and Kiryat Eliezer Industrial Zone. * Tuesdays: Pardes Hagdod, Mechans neighborhood, Kiryat Sanz, Neve Shalom, Ein Tekhelet and the city center – from Herzl Street and north, including Herzl Street. * Wednesdays: Agamim, Ramat Ephraim, Ben Zion, Nof Hataylet, Neve Oz, Galei Yam, Tobruk, Ramat Hen, Geva, Ben Zvi, Ramat Yadin, Neot Shaked and the city center – from Herzl Street and south. * Thursdays: Givat Hayrosim, Ramat Poleg, Neot Menachem Begin, Kiryat Nordau, Neot Golda, Ha'at Hayrok. Instructions regarding the removal of cuttings: * Bulk waste must be separated from cuttings into two separate piles. * Leaf residues and lawn mowing products must be placed packed in bags next to the cutting pile, on the edge of the sidewalk near the house, the evening before removal. * Cuttings are: tree trunks, leaf residues, lawn mowing, etc. * Household waste is: household furniture, garden furniture, electrical appliances, plumbing parts, etc. * Do not place piles of cuttings under electrical wires or near water pipes. * Cuttings and bulky waste must be removed only the evening before the day the municipality clears. * It is strictly forbidden to remove loose trimmings (leaves, grass clippings, etc.) the evening before the evacuation, except in packaged bags only. * Trimming waste up to a quarter of a truck - in coordination with the municipal hotline. * It is strictly forbidden to remove the contents of an entire house the evening before the evacuation. * Removal of: Plant trimmings - two bags only / household items: 2-3 items only, beyond that, a container must be ordered privately for waste removal, apartment renovations will be cleared by the contractor. * Walking/driving routes must not be blocked by trimmings and/or bulky waste. The cranes work in accordance with the defined evacuation days and the division of the city into zones. During an evacuation day in a particular area, the cranes operate from 6:00 until the end of the work day, with the removal of trimming waste and bulky waste being done separately. A Shovel-type tractor and a tilt truck operate next to the trimming cranes. These vehicles are intended for For the removal of debris and lumpy waste from open areas that cranes cannot reach. To contact the City Cleaning Department regarding debris removal, you can call 09-9665976. In addition, you can contact Hotline 106 regarding this matter.

The City Cleaning Department deals with the removal of debris and bulky waste that city residents remove according to evacuation days, handling manual and mechanical street cleaning, cleaning activities at events, vehicle scrap removal, maintenance and operation of public toilets, pest control and carcass removal. Debris removal programs, by days and neighborhoods You can get information by street under the My Environment page . Debris removal days in neighborhoods: * Mondays: Neve Itamar, Neot Ganim, Kiryat Rabin, Mishkenot Zevulun, Train Station, Sha'ar Ha'ir, Kiryat Hasharon, Sapir Business and Technology Park and Kiryat Eliezer Industrial Zone. * Tuesdays: Pardes Hagdod, Mechans neighborhood, Kiryat Sanz, Neve Shalom, Ein Tekhelet and the city center – from Herzl Street and north, including Herzl Street. * Wednesdays: Agamim, Ramat Ephraim, Ben Zion, Nof Hataylet, Neve Oz, Galei Yam, Tobruk, Ramat Hen, Geva, Ben Zvi, Ramat Yadin, Neot Shaked and the city center – from Herzl Street and south. * Thursdays: Givat Hayrosim, Ramat Poleg, Neot Menachem Begin, Kiryat Nordau, Neot Golda, Ha'at Hayrok. Instructions regarding the removal of cuttings: * Bulk waste must be separated from cuttings into two separate piles. * Leaf residues and lawn mowing products must be placed packed in bags next to the cutting pile, on the edge of the sidewalk near the house, the evening before removal. * Cuttings are: tree trunks, leaf residues, lawn mowing, etc. * Household waste is: household furniture, garden furniture, electrical appliances, plumbing parts, etc. * Do not place piles of cuttings under electrical wires or near water pipes. * Cuttings and bulky waste must be removed only the evening before the day the municipality clears. * It is strictly forbidden to remove loose trimmings (leaves, grass clippings, etc.) the evening before the evacuation, except in packaged bags only. * Trimming waste up to a quarter of a truck - in coordination with the municipal hotline. * It is strictly forbidden to remove the contents of an entire house the evening before the evacuation. * Removal of: Plant trimmings - two bags only / household items: 2-3 items only, beyond that, a container must be ordered privately for waste removal, apartment renovations will be cleared by the contractor. * Walking/driving routes must not be blocked by trimmings and/or bulky waste. The cranes work in accordance with the defined evacuation days and the division of the city into zones. During an evacuation day in a particular area, the cranes operate from 6:00 until the end of the work day, with the removal of trimming waste and bulky waste being done separately. A Shovel-type tractor and a tilt truck operate next to the trimming cranes. These vehicles are intended for For the removal of debris and lumpy waste from open areas that cranes cannot reach. To contact the City Cleaning Department regarding debris removal, you can call 09-9665976. In addition, you can contact Hotline 106 regarding this matter.

For advice, guidance, or additional information, you can contact the school counselor or the Secondary Education Division at 09-8362896. For more information about the placement process for educational institutions, you can visit the municipality's website: Placement Process for Educational Institutions , as well as read about the schedule and registration method , and the placement criteria .

text_original: Hello, I'm here to help you with the parking report you received. A parking report details the details of the offense, including the vehicle number, date, location of the offense, the offense section and the amount of the fine, as well as the payment deadline. It is important to pay the report on time to avoid additional enforcement actions. There are several options for handling the report: * **Payment of the report:** * At the Postal Bank with the voucher attached to the report. * At a 24-hour automated call center, using a credit card, at 04-6961340. * On the Metropark website: Payment of a parking report . * **Appealing the report:** An appeal can be filed within 30 days of receiving the notice. The appeal must be submitted in writing and include supporting evidence. An appeal can be filed: * By fax: 15398608609. * By mail: P.O. Box 7031, Netanya, ZIP code 42120. * On the Metropark website: Appealing a parking report . * You can fill out an appeal form for a municipal prosecutor regarding a parking report: Appeal form for a municipal prosecutor regarding a parking report * **Request to be tried:** You can submit a request to be tried within 90 days of receiving the notice, in writing: * By fax: 15398608609. * By mail: P.O. Box 7031, Netanya, ZIP code 42120. * On the Metropark website: Request to be tried for a parking report . * **Request for Report Conversion:** If you did not commit the offense, you can submit a request for the report conversion within 90 days, along with: * An affidavit from the driver who committed the offense, verified by an attorney. * A photocopy of the driver's driver's license. * Can be sent by registered mail to: P.O. Box 7031, Netanya, ZIP Code 42120. For your convenience, you can check the status of a parking ticket on the Metropark website: Check Parking Ticket Status . The Parking and Inspection Department in the Netanya Municipality is responsible for maintaining order and peace in the public space. You can contact the Parking Collection Department by phone at 09-8604427 or by fax at 153-98606509. The department's address is 4 Hatzoran Street, Entrance 7, 2nd Floor, Poleg Industrial Zone, Netanya. label: LOCATION

text_original: Garbage removal in the Ramat Poleg neighborhood is carried out on Thursdays. Bulk waste and grass clippings must be separated into two separate piles. Leaf residues and lawn clippings must be bagged and placed next to the pile of grass clippings, on the curb near the house, the evening before the removal. Grass clippings include tree trunks, leaf residues, and lawn mowing. Household waste includes household furniture, garden furniture, electrical appliances, and plumbing parts. Garbage piles must not be placed under electrical wires or near water pipes. Garbage and bulky waste must only be removed by the municipality the evening before the removal day. It is strictly forbidden to remove loose grass clippings (leaf residues, grass clippings, etc.) the evening before the removal, except in sealed bags only. Vegetation clippings are permitted - two bags only / household items: 2-3 items only. Beyond that, a container must be ordered privately for waste removal. Apartment renovations will be cleared by the contractor. Walking/driving routes must not be blocked by prunings and/or bulky waste. For more information, you can contact the city's cleaning department at 09-9665976. I invite you to visit the pruning removal page on the municipality's website, where you will find more information.

text_original: Hello! I am happy to help you with the issue of electronic waste disposal in our city. Netanya residents can dispose of electronic waste along with the bulky waste on the designated disposal day for their area of ​​residence. In addition, there are special facilities for collecting electronic waste throughout the city. Electronic waste includes: * Electrical appliances * Cell phones * Batteries Electronic waste is transferred to special dismantling and recycling plants, where new batteries are manufactured, zinc and iron are reused, and more. The Netanya Municipality has issued a public tender (36/25) for the establishment and operation of a system for the collection and disposal of electronic waste, equipment and batteries in the city. The tender was published on 05/29/2025, and the deadline for submitting bids is 07/20/2025. For more information, you can contact Itay Yakar, who is responsible for recycling in the Environmental Quality Division, at 0732534282. You can also contact the Garbage Removal Department at 09-8872443 or the Environmental Education Department at 09-8605881. I invite you to visit the Electronic Waste and Battery Removal page on the municipality's website, where you will find more information. label: LOCATION

text_original: Responsibility for the Tobruk field varies depending on the type of field: * **Tobruk Sports Field (Ben Gurion Opposite 11):** Accessible, including accessible parking, an accessible road, accessible toilets, signage and guidance, an audio system and accessible furniture. Accessibility arrangements for buildings * **Tobruk Field (Abrahams Diamond):** A sports field with a surface used for training and sports competitions, an accessible road, an accessible water facility and places for wheelchairs. There is a project to make sports fields accessible in the city, with pitches with proper access roads being made accessible in the first year, while prioritizing different neighborhoods. Accessibility arrangements for buildings * **Tobruk Public Park:** Located in the heart of the Tobruk neighborhood and includes children's playgrounds, grass carpets, trees and well-kept vegetation. The park is accessible and includes a voice guidance/marking system, accessible furniture (benches, trash cans, a water fountain). However, the play facilities are not accessible. Tobruk Public Park
